notes.title: Demo v1.0 released!
notes.content:
What was done:
Added Music

Replaced and added sounds

Rebalanced enemies and weapons

Improved graphics:

Redone some sprites, animations

Replaced old 3D models

Added new 3D Models

New skybox

New menus and fonts

Changed and improved all locations

Added HUD


Further changes will be based on feedback and feedback, the goal is to make a great game!
